key_terms.حَمِيمٍ: An affectionate, intimate friend who provides warmth and support

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says there will be no sincere friend on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the ultimate isolation of the disbeliever on the Day of Judgment, where worldly ties dissolve and only one's deeds remain. It serves as a poignant reminder that true 'friendship' (wilayah) is with Allah and the Ahl al-Bayt, making the absence of a 'close friend' a spiritual void rather than merely a social one. This highlights the transient nature of dunya relationships when divine favor is absent.
